changes.oldText: Use the Connected / Inactive selector to switch between agents that are currently connected and agents that are not. The Inactive list covers terminated, lost, and restarting agents, each marked with its status.
changes.newText: Use the Connected / Terminated selector to switch between agents that are currently connected and agents that have been connected once and then terminated or disconnected. The Terminated list can be used as a reference for node management; if it is empty, then no disconnection or termination has occurred.

changes.oldText: Superadmins can set how client IP addresses are masked before they are stored on the Client IP Masking tab of the Maintenance page. The available policy targets are Default, Login History, and Audit Logs. A target without its own policy follows the Default policy, and when there is no Default policy the addresses are stored as observed.
changes.oldHtml: Superadmins can set how client IP addresses are masked before they are stored on the Client IP Masking tab of the Maintenance page. The available policy targets are Default, Login History, and Audit Logs. A target without its own policy follows the Default policy, and when there is no Default policy the addresses are stored as observed.

changes.oldText: Create Policy: Click Create Policy, choose a Policy Target, and choose a Masking Mode. Only one policy can exist per target.
changes.oldHtml: Create Policy: Click Create Policy, choose a Policy Target, and choose a Masking Mode. Only one policy can exist per target.

changes.oldText: None: Client IPs are stored as observed.
changes.oldHtml: None: Client IPs are stored as observed.

changes.oldText: Truncate: Host bits are zeroed, keeping only the network prefix. Set the IPv4 Prefix Length and IPv6 Prefix Length to choose how many leading bits are kept.
changes.oldHtml: Truncate: Host bits are zeroed, keeping only the network prefix. Set the IPv4 Prefix Length and IPv6 Prefix Length to choose how many leading bits are kept.

changes.oldText: Drop: No client IP is recorded.
changes.oldHtml: Drop: No client IP is recorded.

changes.oldText: Edit: Use the edit action in the row to change the masking mode or the prefix lengths.
changes.oldHtml: Edit: Use the edit action in the row to change the masking mode or the prefix lengths.

changes.oldText: Delete: Use the delete action in the row. The target then falls back to the Default policy.
changes.oldHtml: Delete: Use the delete action in the row. The target then falls back to the Default policy.
